blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Robotic foundation models increasingly build on large pretrained vision-language models [ 4 , 3 ] , video models [ 48 ] , and world action models [ 14 , 27 , 5 ] . Yet selecting and evaluating these models remains expensive: the most reliable test is still closed-loop rollout in simulation [ 29 , 32 ] or the real world [ 1 ] , where evaluation is slow, noisy, and benchmark-dependent. This expense motivates low-cost offline proxies for robotic capability.
blocks.zh: 机器人基础模型越来越多地建立在经过预先训练的大型视觉语言模型[4,3],视频模型[48],以及世界行动模型[14,27,5]之上. 然而,选择和评价这些模型的费用仍然很高:最可靠的测试仍然是模拟[29,32]或现实世界中的封闭式启动,评价缓慢、吵闹和依赖基准。 这笔费用刺激了机器人能力的低成本离线代理。

blocks.en: A natural approach is to use existing perception-side proxies, such as visual question answering scores for VLMs [ 30 , 55 ] or pixel-level video quality for world models [ 17 , 50 , 22 ] . However, these metrics measure passive perception or generation quality, not whether a representation is organized for action [ 57 , 23 , 45 , 34 ] . Two scenes may look visually different but require similar robot motions; conversely, two visually similar scenes may demand different trajectories. For robot task success, a model must produce motions of different tasks even for scenes alike. This requires aligning the visual representation with the motor representation.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的方法是利用现有的感知侧代词,如视觉问答分数为VLM[30,55]或像素级视频质量为世界模型[17,50,22]. 然而,这些衡量标准衡量的是被动感知或生成质量,而不是衡量代表是否组织起来采取行动[57、23、45、34]。 两个场景可能看起来不同但需要类似的机器人运动;反之,两个相像的场景可能需要不同的轨迹. 对于机器人任务的成功,一个模型必须产生不同任务的运动,即使是对场景都一样. 这需要使视觉表现与运动表现一致.

blocks.en:
This perspective connects robotics to the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) [ 20 ] , which argues that as models of different modalities scale and solve diverse tasks, they are converging to a shared statistical model of reality in each of their own representation spaces.
For example, images and text are both projections of a common underlying reality.
As vision and language models scale,
they increasingly agree on the relative distances between data points.
We bring PRH to robotics and ask: can physical motion be viewed as another projection of the world, such that scaled embodied models better align vision and language representations with the structure of robot trajectories?
blocks.zh:
这一视角将机器人与柏拉图表达假说(PRH)[20]联系起来,该假说认为,作为不同模式的模型规模和解决不同的任务,它们正在与各自表达空间中共同的现实统计模型趋同.
例如,图像和文本既是共同的基本现实的预测。
作为视觉和语言模型的尺度,
他们越来越同意数据点之间的相对距离。
我们把PRH带到机器人身上,并问:物理运动是否可被视为世界的另一种投影,这样可以使所包含模型的缩放更好地使视觉和语言表现与机器人轨迹的结构一致?

blocks.en: We test this prediction of PRH: the more capable an embodied model is, the more closely its sensory representations align with its motor representation. In other words, episodes nearby in sensory representation space should also be nearby in motor representation space.
blocks.zh: 我们测试这种对PRH的预测:一个内含的模型的能力越强,其感官表达方式就越接近其运动表达方式. 换句话说,在感官代表空间附近的事件也应该在运动代表空间附近.

blocks.en: We formalize this as Sensorimotor Alignment ( S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} ), a training-free metric, illustrated in Figure 1 . For each episode in a robot dataset, a model’s image and text features form its sensory representation, and the recorded end-effector trajectory forms its motor representation. We measure alignment by comparing each episode’s nearest neighbors in sensory and motor spaces. More overlap between the two neighbor sets means stronger sensorimotor alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们将此正式定为Sensorimotor对齐(S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}),这是无训练的衡量标准,如图1所示。 对于机器人数据集中的每集,模型的图像和文字特征构成其感官表现,记录的末端效应器轨迹构成其运动表现. 我们通过比较每一集在感官空间和运动空间中最近的邻居来测量对齐. 两个相邻的套件之间更多的重叠意味着更强的感官对齐.

blocks.en: In Section 3 , we show that S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates positively with downstream robot task success across model families, in simulated and real-world settings. The correlation is strong for Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) in closed-loop manipulation, indicating that models with higher sensorimotor alignment tend to perform better. S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} computed on raw Vision-Language Models (VLMs) also correlates with the success of the VLAs later fine-tuned from them, more strongly than their general visual question answering (VQA) scores do. For World Action Models (WAMs), S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} is likewise a better indicator of success than video quality metrics such as FID [ 17 ] , SSIM [ 50 ] , and PSNR [ 18 ] , and for real-robot policies, S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} computed offline correlates with physical-robot success under consistent conditions. These results suggest sensorimotor alignment reflects embodied performance better than passive perception or pixel quality.
blocks.zh: 在第3节中,我们显示S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在模拟和现实环境中,与模范家庭的下游机器人任务的成功有着积极的联系。 在闭路操纵中,VLAs对于Vision-Language-Action模型(VLAs)的关联性很强,表明感官比较高的模型往往表现更好. S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在原始视觉-语言模型(VLMs)上计算,也与VLA后来从中微调的成功有关,比一般视觉问答(VQA)分数更强烈. 对于世界行动模式(WAMs),S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}同样是比FID[17],SSIM[50],PSNR[18]等视频质量衡量标准更好的成功指标,对于实际机器人政策,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}离线计算与物理机器人在一致条件下的成功相关。 这些结果表明,感官对齐反应的体现性能优于被动感官或像素质量.

blocks.en: Prior work has observed several phenomena in VLAs and WAMs only through closed-loop results, without explaining them at the representation level. We use S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} to supply that explanation, as shown in Section 4 . For example, fine-tuned VLAs often ignore the language instruction and act mainly on what they see; we find that their task success correlates with the S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} of their vision features, not their text features.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作仅通过闭锁结果在甚高频和甚高频中观察到若干现象,而没有在代表级别上加以解释。 如第4节所示,我们用S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}来提供这一解释。 例如,经过微调的VLA常常忽略语言指示,主要按照他们所看到的来行动;我们发现,他们的任务成功与其视觉特征的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}相关,而不是其文本特征.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • Inspired by the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, we propose a new view of embodiment: stronger embodied models should align their sensory representations more closely with their motor representation. To test this, we introduce S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} , a training-free offline metric that measures alignment between sensory and motor representations. • Across model families, in simulation and on real robots, higher S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} goes with higher task success, making S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} a low-cost offline proxy for choosing models before closed-loop evaluation. • We further find that S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} explains, at the representation level, phenomena that prior work observed only through closed-loop results, making it a diagnostic tool for understanding how design choices shape embodied models.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三层:在柏拉图代表假象的启发下,我们提出了一种新的体现观点:更强大的体现模式应使其感官表现与运动表现更加一致。 为了测试这一点,我们引入了S 2\mathrm{S}^{2},一个无培训的离线度量度量度感官和运动表现的一致. • 跨模范家庭,在模拟和真正的机器人上,更高的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}任务成功率更高,使得S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}成为在闭路评估前选择模型的低成本离线代用。 我们进一步发现,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在代表级别上解释了以前工作只通过闭路结果观察到的现象,使其成为了解设计选择形状如何体现模型的诊断工具。

blocks.en: 3 Sensorimotor Alignment Correlates with Robot Task Success Rate
blocks.zh: 3 与机器人任务成功率相对应的传感器

blocks.en: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) [ 20 ] argues that as models of different modalities become more capable, their representations converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. While the evidence for PRH comes from observational data such as images and text, robotics provides a harder test case: action is not another passive observation, but a physical trajectory through the world. We test the prediction that models whose image–text representations align more closely with end-effector trajectories should achieve higher downstream task success.
blocks.zh: " 柏拉图表示假说 " [20] 认为,随着不同模式的模型能力增强,其表达方式趋于形成一个共同的现实情况统计模型。 虽然PRH的证据来自图像和文本等观测数据,但机器人提供了更难的测试案例:动作不是另一种被动的观测,而是穿过世界的物理轨迹. 我们测试一种预测,即其图像文本表达方式与最终效果轨迹更加一致的模型应该能够取得更高的下游任务成功。

blocks.en: We quantify this alignment using Sensorimotor Alignment ( S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} ), which compares episode neighborhoods in sensory and motor space, as defined in Section 2 . A positive correlation between S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} and task success would provide empirical support for this PRH-inspired view of embodiment. It would also support using S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} as a low-cost offline proxy for deciding which models to evaluate in closed loop first.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Sensorimotor 校正(S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}) 来量化这种校正, 该校正比较了第2节定义的感官和运动空间中的插曲邻里. S2\mathrm{S}^{2}和任务成功之间的正相关关系将为这种由PRH启发的体现观点提供经验支持. 它还会支持使用S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}作为低成本的离线代用,以决定哪些模型先在闭环中进行评价.

blocks.en: Section 3.1 establishes this positive correlation across 3 model families and real-robot policies. Section 3.2 shows that S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates with task success more closely than VQA and video-quality metrics. Section 3.3 confirms that these findings are robust to experimental design choices.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节确立了3个示范家庭和实际机器人政策的正相关关系。 第3.2节显示,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}与任务成功的关系比VQA和视频质量衡量标准更密切。 第3.3节确认,这些结论对于试验性设计选择是强有力的。

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs). We ask whether S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} computed on a raw VLM, before any robot fine-tuning, correlates with the task success of the VLA that is later fine-tuned from that backbone. We compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} for 8 raw VLM backbones from VLM4VLA [ 57 ] and compare it with the SimplerEnv [ 29 ] success rate of the VLAs that VLM4VLA fine-tunes from them. We find a strong correlation, r = + 0.681 r=+0.681 with one-tailed p = 0.031 p=0.031 , as shown in Figure 3 b . blocks.en: World action models (WAMs). Finally, we test WAMs, which build on video generators rather than VLMs. We compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} for 6 WAMs on the bimanual ALOHA dataset [ 59 ] and compare it with their success rates on RoboTwin 2.0 [ 32 ] . For WAMs, the sensory representation is the video-generator latent used for action decoding, and all 6 models share the same ALOHA trajectories and S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} settings. blocks.en: Real-robot policies. We test whether the correlation observed in simulation extends to real robots. Because real-world success rates depend on many factors, such as the task set, robot, cameras, and protocol, we take them all from a single unified setting: the physical-robot results that MolmoB0T [ 10 ] reports for 5 policies on 40 tasks. blocks.en: 3.2 S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} Correlates with Task Success More Closely Than Alternative Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 S 2\ mathrm{S}^{2} 与任务成功更接近于替代计量

blocks.en:
Prior work asks whether offline scores correlate with downstream
task performance.
VLM4VLA [ 57 ] examines the correlation between VQA
benchmark scores and the performance of the resulting VLA policies,
finding weak or even negative correlations.
For video models, Tian et al. [45] find that the quality of predicted video agrees inconsistently with downstream performance across tasks.
A common limitation is that these metrics measure language understanding
or pixel-level video quality, neither of which depends on the motion the robot must execute. S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} instead compares the nearest-neighbor sets of sensory embeddings and motor trajectories.
As we show below, S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates more strongly with task success rate
than any VQA or video-quality metric we evaluate.

blocks.en: 3.3 S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} Is Robust to Evaluation Choices
blocks.zh: 3.3 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2} 是否有能力接受评价选择

blocks.en: We next check that the correlation does not depend on a particular choice of settings. We test this in two ways. First, we vary how S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} is computed and find that the positive correlation with task success holds. Second, as a negative control, we deliberately compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} on reference data from a mismatched embodiment, where a sound metric should lose its correlation with task success. The correlation drops as expected, validating the design of S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} .

4 Representation-Level Explanations with S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2}
blocks.zh: 4 代表级解释,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}

blocks.en: Several phenomena reported for VLAs and WAMs rest only on closed-loop results and still lack a representation-level explanation. Because S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates with task success, as shown in Section 3 , we use it to explain each of these phenomena, as summarized below:
blocks.zh: 所报告的关于志愿军和妇女军的一些现象仅依赖于闭关结果,仍然缺乏代表性的解释。 由于S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}与任务成功有关,如第3节所示,我们用它来解释这些现象的每一个,概述如下:

blocks.en:
• Modality dominance :
prior work observes that VLAs often struggle with instruction grounding: they act on what the scene visually suggests rather than on what the language instruction asks [ 13 , 12 , 58 ] .
In Section 4.1 , we explain that after VLA fine-tuning, task success is associated with vision-feature S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} but not text-feature S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} , indicating that fine-tuned VLAs draw on what they see, not on the instruction, to produce their motion. • Frozen encoders :
prior work observes that freezing the vision encoder during VLA fine-tuning degrades downstream task performance [ 57 ] .
In Section 4.2 , we explain that freezing also prevents the S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} gain from end-to-end fine-tuning, indicating that VLAs gain performance by bringing their sensory representation closer to the motor representation. • Iterative denoising :
prior work observes that WAMs can skip iterative video denoising at test time, decoding actions without generating future video, with little loss in task success [ 54 ] .
In Section 4.3 , we explain that the S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} of WAM features is already high at the earliest denoising step and changes little afterwards, indicating that the first denoising steps already yield features aligned closely enough with robot trajectories to act on. • Mid-depth blocks :
prior work observes that mid-depth blocks of video diffusion transformers matter most for semantic reasoning [ 49 ] .
In Section 4.4 , we explain that these blocks also carry the strongest S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} , indicating that the layers that reason about video semantics are also the layers most aligned with robot motion.
blocks.zh:
• 模式主导:
以前的工作表明,志愿军经常在教学上挣扎:他们根据场景的视觉暗示行事,而不是根据语言教学的要求行事[13、12、58]。
在第4.1节中,我们解释说,在VLA微调后,任务的成功与视觉特性S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}有关,但与文本特性S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}无关,表明微调的VLA借鉴了他们所看到的,而不是指示,以产生他们的运动. • 冻结编码器:
以前的工作表明,VLA微调时冷冻视觉编码器会降低下游任务性能[57].
在4.2节中,我们解释说,冻结也阻止了S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}从端对端微调中得益,表明VLAs通过使其感官表现更接近运动代表来获得性能. • 支助 迭代:
先前的工作观察到,WAMs可以在测试时间跳过迭代视频解码,解码动作而不产生未来的视频,任务成功几乎没有损失[54].
在第4.3节中,我们解释说,WAM的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}特性在最早的去诺音阶上已经很高,之后几乎没有变化,这表明第一个去诺音阶已经产生足够与机器人轨迹紧密一致的特性来采取行动。 • 中深层街区:
先前的工作表明,对于语义推理而言,视频传播变压器的中深块最为重要[49].
在4.4节中,我们解释这些块还携带最强的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2},说明视频语义的原因的层也是最符合机器人运动的层.

Modality dominance :
prior work observes that VLAs often struggle with instruction grounding: they act on what the scene visually suggests rather than on what the language instruction asks [ 13 , 12 , 58 ] .
In Section 4.1 , we explain that after VLA fine-tuning, task success is associated with vision-feature S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} but not text-feature S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} , indicating that fine-tuned VLAs draw on what they see, not on the instruction, to produce their motion.

模式主导:
以前的工作表明,志愿军经常在教学上挣扎:他们根据场景的视觉暗示行事,而不是根据语言教学的要求行事[13、12、58]。
在第4.1节中,我们解释说,在VLA微调后,任务的成功与视觉特性S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}有关,但与文本特性S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}无关,表明微调的VLA借鉴了他们所看到的,而不是指示,以产生他们的运动.

blocks.en:
Frozen encoders :
prior work observes that freezing the vision encoder during VLA fine-tuning degrades downstream task performance [ 57 ] .
In Section 4.2 , we explain that freezing also prevents the S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} gain from end-to-end fine-tuning, indicating that VLAs gain performance by bringing their sensory representation closer to the motor representation.
blocks.zh:
冻结编码器 :
以前的工作表明,VLA微调时冷冻视觉编码器会降低下游任务性能[57].
在4.2节中,我们解释说,冻结也阻止了S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}从端对端微调中得益,表明VLAs通过使其感官表现更接近运动代表来获得性能.

blocks.en:
Iterative denoising :
prior work observes that WAMs can skip iterative video denoising at test time, decoding actions without generating future video, with little loss in task success [ 54 ] .
In Section 4.3 , we explain that the S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} of WAM features is already high at the earliest denoising step and changes little afterwards, indicating that the first denoising steps already yield features aligned closely enough with robot trajectories to act on.
blocks.zh:
迭代:
先前的工作观察到,WAMs可以在测试时间跳过迭代视频解码,解码动作而不产生未来的视频,任务成功几乎没有损失[54].
在第4.3节中,我们解释说,WAM的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}特性在最早的去诺音阶上已经很高,之后几乎没有变化,这表明第一个去诺音阶已经产生足够与机器人轨迹紧密一致的特性来采取行动。

blocks.en:
Mid-depth blocks :
prior work observes that mid-depth blocks of video diffusion transformers matter most for semantic reasoning [ 49 ] .
In Section 4.4 , we explain that these blocks also carry the strongest S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} , indicating that the layers that reason about video semantics are also the layers most aligned with robot motion.
blocks.zh:
中深度块 :
先前的工作表明,对于语义推理而言,视频传播变压器的中深块最为重要[49].
在4.4节中,我们解释这些块还携带最强的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2},说明视频语义的原因的层也是最符合机器人运动的层.

blocks.en: 4.1 What Carries the Correlation: Vision, Text, or Both?
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 何物与关联:视觉,文字,还是两者?

blocks.en: VLAs often struggle with instruction grounding [ 13 , 12 , 58 ] . We use S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} to explain this at the representation level, asking which modality the correlation with task success depends on: vision, text, or both. In Figure 8 , we compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} separately for each modality. We take the VLM output tokens read by the action head and form vision features from the image tokens, text features from the instruction tokens, and joint vision-text features from all tokens.
blocks.zh: 志愿军经常与教导打基础斗争[13,12,58]. 我们用S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在代表级别上解释这一点,询问与任务成功的相关性取决于:愿景、文本或两者。 在图8中,我们对每种模式分别计算S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}。 我们把动作头所读的VLM输出符,从图像符中形成视觉特征,从指令符中形成文字特征,从所有符中形成联合视觉文本特征.

blocks.en: Fine-tuned VLAs rely mainly on visual rather than language representations. In the 12 fine-tuned VLAs, S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} from vision features correlates with SimplerEnv success rate at r = + 0.694 r\!=\!{+}0.694 , nearly matching the joint vision-text features at r = + 0.699 r\!=\!{+}0.699 , whereas text features show no significant correlation at r = + 0.237 r\!=\!{+}0.237 . The raw VLMs reverse this pattern: before fine-tuning, text features correlate at r = + 0.501 r\!=\!{+}0.501 , more strongly than vision features at r = + 0.425 r\!=\!{+}0.425 , and joint vision-text features correlate most strongly at r = + 0.681 r\!=\!{+}0.681 .

We infer that, after fine-tuning, VLAs produce their motion mainly from visual rather than language representations, which explains their weak instruction grounding at the representation level. Appendix D.1 reports per-model S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} at all feature positions.
blocks.zh: 我们推断,经过微调后,VLA主要通过视觉而非语言表达来产生其运动,这解释了其在表达层面的薄弱教学基础. 附录D.1报告S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}所有特写位置。

blocks.en: VLM4VLA [ 57 ] reports that VLAs perform substantially worse when their vision encoder stays frozen during fine-tuning. We use S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} to explain this drop at the representation level, testing whether freezing also prevents the sensorimotor-alignment gain from end-to-end fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 常规LM4VLA [57] 报告说,VLA在微调时其视觉编码器保持冷冻时表现要糟糕得多. 我们用S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}来解释这种在表示级别上的下降,测试冻结是否也阻止了端到端的微调产生的感官对调收益.

blocks.en: In Figure 9 , we compare 2 VLAs that follow the same VLM4VLA [ 57 ] recipe and differ only in whether the vision encoder is trained or kept frozen. For each, we compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} and measure SimplerEnv success rate. Freezing the encoder reduces S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} by 41 % 41\% and the success rate by 40 % 40\% , with more detail in Appendix D.2 . These results suggest that end-to-end fine-tuning improves performance by aligning the sensory representation more closely with the motor representation.
blocks.zh: 在图9中,我们比较了遵循相同的VLM4VLA[57]配方的2个VLA,仅在视觉编码器是否经过培训或保持冷冻方面有所不同. 对每一个, 我们计算 S 2\ mathrm{S}^{2} 并测量 SimmerEnv 成功率 。 冷冻编码器将S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}减少41% 41\%,成功率减少40% 40\%,详见附录D.2. 这些结果表明,端到端的微调通过使感官表现与运动表现更紧密地对调来提高性能.

blocks.en: Most WAMs generate future video through iterative denoising and decode actions from the resulting latents. Fast-WAM [ 54 ] shows that WAMs can skip this video generation and decode actions directly, with little loss in task success. We examine the representation-level reason: whether features at the earliest denoising steps already align with robot trajectories.
blocks.zh: 大多数WAM通过迭代解码和解码动作从由此产生的潜伏中生成未来的视频. Fast-WAM [54] 显示WAMs可以直接跳过这款视频生成并解码动作,在任务成功方面几乎没有损失. 我们研究了表现层面的原因:最早的去名步骤是否已经与机器人轨道一致。

blocks.en: We measure S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} for 3 WAMs [ 5 , 27 , 14 ] on RoboTwin [ 32 ] , as shown in Figure 10(a) . We compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} from each model’s latent features at 5 positions in its native denoising schedule, from 0 % 0\% to 100 % 100\% , not at matched noise levels. S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} is already high at the earliest step and remains nearly flat, varying by about 6 % 6\% at most from its initial value across the 3 models. We infer that early-step features are already sufficiently aligned with robot trajectories to generate actions. Because S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates with WAM success rate, as shown in Section 3.1 , this result explains why skipping iterative video denoising barely lowers task success.
blocks.zh: 如图10(a)所示,我们在 RoboTwin [32] 上为3个WAM [5、27、14] 测量 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}。 我们从每个模型的潜在特征中计算出S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}, 其原生的去诺计时表中的5个位置, 从0% 0\%到100% 100\%不等, S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在最早的一步中已经很高,并且仍然几乎保持平坦,最多与3种模型的初始值相差6%左右。 我们推断早期的步态特征已经与机器人轨迹充分一致,可以产生动作. 因为S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}与WAM的成功率相关, 如第3.1节所示,

blocks.en: 4.4 Mid-Depth Blocks Carry the Strongest Sensorimotor Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.4 中深度区块承载最强的感光运动对齐

blocks.en: Prior analysis of Chain-of-Steps [ 49 ] shows that mid-depth layers in Video Diffusion Transformers are especially important for semantic reasoning over objects and interactions. We ask whether the layers with the highest S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} also lie in this mid-depth range.
blocks.zh: 之前对链条(chain-of-Steps)的分析[49]表明,视频传播变形器的中深层对于语义推理相对于对象和相互作用尤为重要. 我们问,最高的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}层是否也位于这个中深层。

blocks.en: In Figure 10(b) , we compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} at different depths of 3 WAMs [ 5 , 27 , 14 ] on RoboTwin. All 3 share a 30-block video backbone; we extract features from Blocks 0, 7, 14, 21, and 29. Block 14 yields the highest S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} in every model. This peak falls in the mid-depth range that Chain-of-Steps [ 49 ] identifies as semantically important, suggesting that the layers handling video semantic reasoning align most closely with robot motion. Details are in Appendix D.3 .
blocks.zh: 在图10(b)中,我们在RoboTwin上的3个WAM[5,27,14]的不同深度计算S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}. 所有3人共享30块的视频主干线;我们从0,7,14,21和29区抽取功能. 区块14的产量是每个型号中最高的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}. 这一峰值跌落到链条[49]认定为具有高度重要性的中深度范围,表明处理视频语义推理的层层与机器人运动最接近. 详情见附录D.3。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Representation learning in robotics. Many robotics studies pretrain visual representations to improve task performance [ 33 , 38 , 31 ] . However, there remains limited understanding of which representational properties lead to downstream task success. A few studies ask what makes a pretrained vision encoder useful for robot learning. Hu et al. [19] evaluate 14 frozen vision encoders and find that the correlation between vision encoder and downstream task success rate is not stable across policy-learning methods. Burns et al. [8] find that emergent segmentation predicts manipulation success under visual distribution shifts, but only for Vision Transformers. Theia [ 41 ] hypothesizes that higher feature-norm entropy improves robot learning, but reports the supporting correlations only within separate groups of encoders. These studies examine only vision encoders rather than a broader range of embodied models, and none of them accounts for the trajectories the robot executes when measuring the representation. By contrast, S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} compares k k -nearest-neighbor sets in sensory and motor spaces, grounding the evaluation in robot behavior. The same S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} measure correlates with success across VLAs, raw VLMs, WAMs, and the encoders that Hu et al. [19] evaluate.
blocks.zh: 代表学习机器人. 许多机器人研究预选视觉表现,以提高任务性能[33,38,31]. 然而,对哪些代表性特性导致下游任务的成功的认识仍然有限。 少数研究问,如何使预先训练的视觉编码器对机器人学习有用. 胡等编著. [19]评价14个冷冻的视觉编码器,发现视觉编码器与下游任务成功率之间的关联性在政策学习方法上并不稳定. 伯恩斯等人著. [8] 发现即兴分解预言在视觉分布变换下操纵成功,但只针对Vision Transformers. Theia [41] 假设更高特性规范的entropy能改进机器人的学习,但只报告辅助关联在单独的编码器组内. 这些研究只研究视觉编码器,而不是更广泛的包含模型,没有一项能说明机器人在测量表示时所执行的轨迹. 相比之下,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在感官空间和运动空间中比较了k k - 近邻的集,在机器人行为中将评价搁浅. 同样的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2} 测量与成功相关, 跨VLA, 原始VLM, WAM, 以及Hu等人的编码器。 [19] 评价。

blocks.en: Platonic Representation Hypothesis. Recent work has applied the Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) [ 20 ] to several new domains. In image generation, REPA [ 52 ] aligns diffusion-transformer features with self-supervised vision encoders, improving training speed and quality. CREPA [ 21 ] extends this recipe to video diffusion. In multimodal understanding, VIRAL [ 51 ] re-aligns multimodal large language models (LLMs) with their vision encoders, recovering visual detail lost in multimodal training. For cross-modal alignment, Schnaus et al. [40] match independently trained vision and language encoders through their shared geometry, without paired data. PRH has not yet been brought into robotics; we extend it to robotics by treating robot trajectories as another projection of the world, and find that more capable embodied models align their sensory representations more closely with it.
blocks.zh: 柏拉图代表假说. 最近的工作将柏拉图代表假说[20]应用于几个新的领域。 在图像生成中,REPA[52]将扩散-转换特性与自我监督的视觉编码器对齐,提高了训练速度和质量. CREPA[21]将这个食谱扩展至视频传播. 在多式联运理解中,VIRAL[51]用其视觉编码器重新排列多式联运大型语言模型,恢复在多式联运培训中丢失的视觉细节。 关于跨模式对接,Schnaus等人。 [40] 通过共享几何来匹配独立训练的视觉和语言编码器,没有配对数据. PRH还没有被带入机器人领域;我们通过将机器人的轨迹作为世界的另一种投影来将其推广到机器人领域,并且发现更能体现的模型更紧密地使其感官表达与它一致.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Sensorimotor Alignment ( S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} ), a training-free offline metric of alignment between sensory representations and end-effector trajectories. Across VLAs, raw VLMs, and WAMs in simulation, and across real-robot policies, S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates positively with downstream task success, which supports this PRH-inspired view of embodiment. S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} correlates more strongly with success than VQA scores and video-quality metrics, and explains, at the representation level, VLA and WAM phenomena previously seen only in closed-loop behavior: modality dominance, the performance drop from freezing the vision encoder, the small task-success cost of skipping iterative denoising, and the importance of mid-depth blocks for semantic reasoning. We use S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} only offline as a low-cost model-selection and diagnostic tool before closed-loop evaluation, but this correlation motivates optimizing embodied models directly for sensorimotor alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍Sensorimotor对齐(S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}),这是感官表达和终端效应轨迹之间的无培训离线度量。 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在VLA、原始VLM和WAM的模拟中,在实际机器人政策中,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}与下游任务的成功有着积极的联系,这支持这种由PRH启发的体现观点。 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}与成功的关系比VQA分数和视频质量的度量标准更紧密,在代表级别上解释VLA和WAM现象过去只见于闭路行为:模式主导,性能从视觉编码器冻结下降,跳过迭代解密的小型任务成功成本,以及中深块对语义推理的重要性. 我们只使用S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}作为闭路评估前的低成本模型选择和诊断工具,但这种相关性激励了直接用于感官对齐的内含模型优化.

blocks.en: Limitations. Our study has three main limitations. (1) The positive relationship between S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} and task success is correlational across the tested models; we have not yet demonstrated that sensorimotor alignment can be used directly during training to improve task success rates. (2) Models with similar S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} values can still achieve different success rates, so S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} is best used as a low-cost offline proxy for identifying promising models and VLM backbones before costly fine-tuning or closed-loop testing, which remains the final step of model selection. (3) Our evaluation covers limited model families, benchmarks, and training recipes, few models per comparison, and a single real-robot setting; broader generalization remains to be tested.
blocks.zh: 限制。 我们的研究有三个主要局限。 (1)S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}和任务成功之间的正关系是经过测试的模型之间相互关联的;我们尚未证明在训练中可以直接使用感应器对齐以提高任务成功率. (2)具有相似的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}值的模型仍然可以实现不同的成功率,因此S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}最好作为低成本的离线代用,在成本高昂的微调或闭路测试前识别有前途的模型和VLM主干线,这仍然是模型选择的最后一步. (3)我们的评价涵盖有限的模范家庭、基准和培训方法,每次比较的模型很少,以及一个单一的实际机器人设定;更广泛的概括性仍有待测试。

blocks.en: This section gives the full computation of S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} summarized in Section 2 : the reference datasets and how we sample from them, the trajectory distance that defines motor neighbors, and the estimator that scores alignment between sensory and motor neighbor sets.
blocks.zh: 本节给出了第2节中总结的S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}的全部计算:参考数据集和我们从中取样的方式,定义运动邻位的轨迹距离,以及感官邻位和运动邻位对齐的算法.

blocks.en: A.1 Reference Datasets and Sampling
blocks.zh: A.1 参考数据集和抽样

blocks.en: We use three reference datasets. We use the single-arm DROID and BridgeDataV2 datasets for VLAs, raw VLMs, frozen vision encoders, and real-robot policies. ALOHA is a bimanual dataset, which we use for the WAMs. DROID and BridgeDataV2 contain teleoperated robot demonstrations with RGB images, proprioceptive states, and language task annotations. Each state is a 7D vector 𝐬 = ( x , y , z , ϕ , θ , ψ , g ) \mathbf{s}=(x,y,z,\phi,\theta,\psi,g) , where ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) is the end-effector position in meters, ( ϕ , θ , ψ ) (\phi,\theta,\psi) are the roll, pitch, and yaw angles in radians, and g g is the recorded gripper position. This shared format supports the same DTW and S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} computation on both single-arm datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个参考数据集。 我们使用单臂DROID和BridgeDataV2数据集用于VLA,原始VLM,冷冻视觉编码器,以及真机器人政策. ALOHA是一个双人数据集,我们用来用于WAMs. DROID和BridgeDataV2包含带有RGB图像,自主状态,语言任务说明的远程操作机器人演示. 每个状态为7D矢量s=(x,y,z,φ,θ, g,g)\mathbf{(x,y,z,\phi,\theta,\psi,g),其中(x,y,z,x,y,z)为仪表中的终效方位,(φ,θ,\phi,\theta,\psi)是弧度的滚,抛,和弧角,g是记录的抓力方位. 这种共享格式支持相同的DTW和S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在两个单臂数据集上进行计算.

blocks.en: BridgeDataV2. BridgeDataV2 [ 47 ] contains 53,192 WidowX episodes recorded at 5 Hz. We use the recorded 7D state and retain 38,307 episodes with non-empty task labels.

blocks.en: DROID. DROID [ 25 ] contains 95,658 episodes on a Franka Panda arm recorded at 15 Hz, spanning 86 task categories across 564 scenes in offices, kitchens, and homes. We form the 7D state by concatenating the 6D Cartesian end-effector pose with the gripper position, which is 0 0 when open and 1 1 when closed. We retain episodes with a language annotation. As the observation image, we use the exterior_image_1_left camera at × 320 180\!\times\!320 , the fixed exterior view closest to the third-person camera of BridgeDataV2.

blocks.en: We follow the progression from HSIC to CKA and centered kernel nearest-neighbor alignment (CKNNA) in Appendix A of Huh et al. [20] , specializing their construction to a sensory kernel and a motor neighbor matrix. CKA scores alignment across all sample pairs; CKNNA restricts the comparison to mutual nearest neighbors, which measures alignment locally.
blocks.zh: 我们关注从HSIC到CKA的进度,并在Huh等人的附录A中以内核近邻对齐(CKNNA)为中心. [20],将其构造专门用于感官内核和运动邻居矩阵. CKA在所有样本对齐中得分对齐;CKNNA限制与最近相互邻邻的比较,这可以衡量本地对齐.

blocks.en: B.1 Vision-Language-Action Models
blocks.zh: B.1 愿景-语言-行动模式

blocks.en: The 12 evaluated VLAs include 5 StarVLA [ 43 ] variants (Qwen2.5-GR00T-Bridge, Qwen2.5-GR00T-RT-1-Bridge, Qwen2.5-OFT-RT-1-Bridge, Qwen3-GR00T-RT-1-Bridge, and Qwen3-OFT-RT-1-Bridge), CogACT [ 28 ] in Small, Base, and Large sizes, GR00T-N1.5-Bridge, GR00T-N1.6-Bridge [ 6 ] , Pi0-Bridge [ 7 ] , and SpatialVLA-Bridge [ 36 ] . They cover 4 action-head types (flow matching, diffusion, autoregressive, and deterministic MLP) and 3 VLM training regimes, from frozen to end-to-end. We use reported SimplerEnv success rates from the model papers and public evaluation repositories, including https://github.com/starVLA/starVLA and https://github.com/DelinQu/SimplerEnv-OpenVLA .

blocks.zh: B.2 与VLA相关联的控制

blocks.en: The 12 VLAs in Appendix B.1 differ in architecture, model scale, pretraining data, action head, and training recipe. Three checks show that none of these factors alone explains the correlation. Each check retains its main-paper experiment’s reference data and feature settings.

blocks.en: B.3 Raw Vision-Language Models

blocks.en: We evaluate VLM4VLA’s [ 57 ] 8 raw VLMs: KosMos-2 [ 35 ] , PaliGemma [ 4 ] , PaliGemma 2 [ 44 ] , Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 3 ] , and Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B, and Qwen3-VL-8B [ 2 ] . Their success rates come from the VLAs that VLM4VLA fine-tunes from each backbone on BridgeDataV2 and evaluates on SimplerEnv. We compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} on the raw backbones before any robot fine-tuning, using DROID [ 25 ] as the reference dataset, which differs from the fine-tuning data in robot and scenes. We use h = 3 h=3 and pool image and instruction tokens.

For all 6 models, we compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} on identical bimanual ALOHA trajectories, fixing feature position, trajectory horizon, number of neighbors, and DTW computation. The reported comparison uses video-backbone Block 7 features at h = 15 h=15 and k = 10 k=10 .

blocks.en: B.5 Real-Robot Policies
blocks.zh: B.5 实际机器人政策

blocks.en: We use success rates from MolmoB0T’s physical-robot evaluation [ 10 ] , which tests all policies on the same tasks, robots, and cameras. Policies run on 3 Franka DROID platforms in 4 environments (kitchen, workroom, bedroom, and office) at 2 institutions. Each environment has 10 pick-and-place tasks with 3 trials per task, giving 120 trials per policy. A trial succeeds if the policy places the named object stably in or on the receptacle within 900 steps. The evaluation compares 5 policies, three MolmoB0T variants (MolmoB0T, MolmoB0T-Img, and MolmoB0T-Pi0) and two baselines ( π 0 \pi_{0} -DROID and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} -DROID). We compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} from public checkpoints’ joint LLM-output features on the 6,000-episode DROID subset at h = 110 h=110 . This is an exploratory horizon; the prespecified h = 7 h=7 gives r = + 0.429 r=+0.429 with one-tailed p = 0.236 p=0.236 .

blocks.en: B.6 Frozen Vision Encoders Under Downstream Policy Learning
blocks.zh: B.6 下游政策学习下的冻结愿景编码器

blocks.en: We ask whether S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} can rank frozen vision backbones without training a policy. Hu et al. [19] provide a benchmark: they evaluate 14 pretrained vision backbones (9 ResNet-50 [ 16 ] and 5 ViT-B/16 [ 11 ] ) on 21 tasks in Meta-World [ 53 ] , Robosuite [ 60 ] , and Franka-Kitchen [ 15 ] . For each backbone, they freeze it and train policies on top, so only the backbone changes. We compute S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} for their released checkpoints on the same 6,000-episode DROID subset as in the main paper, with all other settings unchanged. We take the interquartile mean (IQM) success rates from their paper for two policy-learning methods. Behavior cloning (BC) learns from expert demonstrations, and we use the smallest budget of 1 demonstration per task (5 on Robosuite). The visual reward function (VRF) method uses reinforcement learning, with rewards computed from distances between the backbone’s embeddings of agent and expert observations.
blocks.zh: 我们问,S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}是否可以在不训练政策的情况下对冻结的视觉骨干进行排名。 胡等编著. [19]提供了一个基准:他们评价了在Meta-World [53],Robosuite [60],以及Franka-Kitchen [15] 的21项任务上的14个预先训练的视觉主干(9 ResNet-50 [16]和5 Vit-B/16 [11]). 对于每个骨干,他们冻结它,并在顶部训练政策,所以只有骨干改变. 我们计算S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}在主纸上相同的6000集DROID子集上释放的检查站,所有其他设置不变。 我们从他们的论文中得出两个政策学习方法的平分率。 行为克隆(BC)从专家演示中吸取教训,我们使用每个任务一个演示(Robosuite上的5个)的最小预算. 视觉奖励功能(VRF)方法采用强化学习,奖励从骨干嵌入剂与专家观察之间的距离计算。

blocks.en: We find a strong correlation between the backbone’s S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} and downstream task success under both policy-learning methods, as shown in Figure 11 . For BC, r = + 0.677 r=+0.677 with one-tailed p = 0.004 p=0.004 . For VRF, r = + 0.774 r=+0.774 with one-tailed p < 0.001 p<0.001 . Both methods rely directly on the frozen representation: low-data BC maps frozen features to actions from as little as one demonstration per task, and VRF computes its reward from distances in the embedding space. The correlation follows how strongly the policy relies on the representation. blocks.en: A useful offline metric should respond when the reference data no longer matches the target robot. We test this with 3 bimanual WAMs evaluated on RoboTwin, scoring them with two reference datasets that differ in arm configuration, as shown in Figure 12 . With the matched bimanual ALOHA reference [ 59 ] , S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} recovers the success-rate order of all 3 models, at r = + 0.999 r\!=\!{+}0.999 . With the single-arm DROID reference, the correlation drops to r = + 0.246 r\!=\!{+}0.246 with p = 0.421 p\!=\!0.421 . S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} therefore responds to the mismatch in arm configuration rather than reporting alignment indiscriminately. This sensitivity complements the stability across single-arm references in Section 3.3 , where DROID and BridgeDataV2 differ in robot, scenes, and tasks yet give nearly the same correlation for the 12 VLAs. A reference dataset therefore need not come from the exact target robot, but it should match the target’s arm configuration.

blocks.en: Behavioral validation. To check that S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} along the denoising schedule correlates with task success, we vary the number of video denoising steps in LingBot-VA [ 27 ] . We measure S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} and closed-loop success rate on the RoboTwin turn_switch task over 100 episodes. Reducing the steps from the default 25 to 5 lowers the success rate from 56 % 56\% to 48 % 48\% and S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} from 0.288 0.288 to 0.241 0.241 , so S 2 \mathrm{S}^{2} and task success change together.
blocks.zh: 行为鉴定. 为了检查S 2\mathrm{S}^{2}与任务成功相关联, 我们更改了LingBot-VA的视频解密步骤数 [27] 。 我们在 RoboTwin turn_switch 任务上测量了 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2} 和闭路成功率 。 将步骤从默认的 25 降为 5 , 将成功率从 56 % 56% 降为 48% 48% 和 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2} 从 0.288 0 288 降为 0.241 0.241, 所以 S 2\mathrm{S}^{2} 并共同任务成功变化 。
